more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain chewing gum.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.overview: Zinc acetate is a zinc salt of acetic acid specified in hydrated crystalline form. It is used to strengthen an existing taste or aroma in the food. The specified material is supplied as off-white powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include chewing gum.
